name: m8_ranking
_doc: M8 shape-ranking harness (PLAN M8 gate). Runs procedural reference shapes (plate / ring / cup) on the live morphodynamic pipeline in a compact patch, records trapped-sand volume V_trap(t) + edge scour, fits equilibria (exp + Welzel, run_protocol.h) with CIs, and ranks by fitted V_eq. Comparative/qualitative — the tool's stated authority (RESEARCH §11); absolute magnitudes inherit the gate_M6 HSV under-prediction. Open-sea suspended boundary supplies the ambient load. Run: build/Release/scour_m8_gate.exe configs/m8_ranking.json [--quick] [--shapes plate,ring,cup] [--csv out.csv].
